_comment: Kibale NP lodge — project config. Goes BESIDE the .rvt, not in the project folder. Apply BEFORE the first tag write.
_loc_note: All THREE keys carry the same list on purpose. LOC_CODES feeds TagConfig (tag writer, Excel import, picklists); CUSTOM_VALID_LOC is the ONLY key ISO19650Validator honours; LOC_CODES_EXTRA is read only by FederationReview and BuildingAwareCDEFolders. See gap F-1. COT01 is deliberately first: TagConfig.cs:2295 files any underivable LOC under the first non-XX code, so put the cottage you are most likely to notice at the front and audit the distribution after tagging.
_zone_note: Z01 Guest accommodation · Z02 Public/hospitality (reception, kitchen, dining, pool, camp fire) · Z03 Back-of-house (staff lodge, laundry, back space) · Z04 External works, roads, retaining, drainage. See the playbook, Part 2A.
_strict_note: Default is lenient, which accepts ANY 1-8 alphanumeric LOC silently. Strict makes ValidateTags actually check against CUSTOM_VALID_LOC. Turn it on now, while the model is small.
_fx_note: Read by BOQCostManager.cs:700-704. Set the rate you have actually agreed with the QS before the first export. Not in the known-keys whitelist, so it will log a warning; it still works.
_waste_note: Material-specific waste never reaches a PRICED quantity — all three cost call sites pass material=null (gap E-4). Only this project default and the category keyword apply. Build the difference into your rates.
_coststamp_note: Leave OFF until the material rate defect (gap E-1) is fixed. With it on, every tag pass stamps CST_* parameters from a rate chain whose top provider is ~3700x low.
_tagger_note: Leave the live auto-tagger OFF while you build C01. Turn it on only once the cottage validates clean, or you will be fixing tags on geometry you are still moving.
_formula_note: The tag pipeline's formula cache is TTL-only and does NOT check the CSV mtime (gap G-9). A short TTL limits how long a stale formula set survives if anyone edits FORMULAS_WITH_DEPENDENCIES.csv mid-session.
_seq_note: SEQ_INCLUDE_LOC keeps sequence numbers unique per building. Without it, COT01-0001 and COT02-0001 collide across the eight cottages.
